description: This source file implements credential cache management in Git, including functions for connecting to a Unix socket, spawning a cache daemon, sending requests, and handling different credential cache actions such as get, store, erase, and exit.

methods.name: int connection_closed(int error)
methods.description: Checks if an error code indicates a closed connection, varies between Windows and Unix implementations.

methods.name: int connection_fatally_broken(int error)
methods.description: Checks if an error code indicates a fatal connection break.

methods.name: int send_request(const char * socket,const struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Sends a request to the credential cache daemon via Unix socket and reads the response.

methods.name: void spawn_daemon(const char * socket)
methods.description: Spawns the credential cache daemon process.

methods.name: void do_cache(const char * socket,const char * action,int timeout,int flags)
methods.description: Performs cache actions like get, store, erase, or exit, handling communication and possible daemon restart.

methods.name: char * get_socket_path(void)
methods.description: Determines the path to the credential cache socket.

methods.name: int cmd_credential_cache(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command handler for credential cache operations, processes command-line arguments.
